    total = a + b + c
    if total % 2 != 0:
        return "No"
    
    target = total // 2
    dp = [False] * (target + 1)
    dp[0] = True
    
    for x in [a, b, c]:
        for j in range(target, x - 1, -1):
            dp[j] = dp[j] or dp[j - x]
    
    return "Yes" if dp[target] else "No"

    total = a + b + c
    if total % 2 != 0:
        return "No"
    
    target = total // 2
    dp = [False] * (target + 1)
    dp[0] = True
    
    for x in [a, b, c]:
        for j in range(target, x - 1, -1):
            dp[j] = dp[j] or dp[j - x]
    
    return "Yes" if dp[target] else "No"
